verdict.rationale: AiPrise is a verification and compliance platform, so funnel analytics is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions pass-rate, drop-off, or completion-time analytics broken down by country or document type. Dashboard flow editing and auto-decisioning thresholds are adjacent features and do not count as funnel reporting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
